infobox.usage: Unlocks the marked electrical substation at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Substation marked key (Substation) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key with some strange symbols scratched onto it. Seems to be used for unlocking the electrical substation at the water treatment plant near the Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the the marked electrical substation at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (Weapon case, modified Weapons, Weapon mods, )
